name: thread
title: Thread
description: Comments and their replies, each joined by a line to the comment it answers.
use: A discussion under something: comments on a document, a review, an issue. Replies nest in a list inside the comment they answer, and a hairline runs from its avatar into each of them. Use the default avatar for a comment and avatar-sm for a reply, and keep nesting to two or three levels.

instead.when: It is a conversation in turns between two sides, as in a chat
The entries are events in time and nobody answers anybody
The rows are things with no order and no replies

classes.name: thread-item
classes.description: One comment: its avatar on a column, its words beside it and its replies under the words

classes.name: thread-avatar
classes.description: The avatar's column, around an avatar; under the avatar the line begins when replies follow

classes.name: thread-body
classes.description: The words: a thread-header and the thread-text under it. The first line is level with the middle of the avatar

classes.name: thread-header
classes.description: The first line of the body: the author, and the time beside the name

classes.name: thread-text
classes.description: What they wrote, in the body under the header; several paragraphs stand 8px apart

classes.name: thread-author
classes.description: Who wrote it, in strong ink

classes.name: thread-meta
classes.description: When, and anything else said quietly beside the name

classes.name: thread-replies
classes.description: The list of replies inside a thread-item, after its body; each reply is a thread-item joined to the comment by an elbow of the line

properties.name: --thread-avatar
properties.description: Size of a comment's avatar; replies use 1.5rem

properties.name: --thread-gap
properties.description: Space between an avatar and its words

properties.name: --thread-space
properties.description: Space between comments; replies stand .875rem apart

example:
1. AL

    Ada Lovelace 2h

    Should the focus ring move to the group?

    1. AT

      Alan Turing 1h

      Yes. The group already has the corner.
